title: Ovid2 pipeline dictionaries — documented convention
description: Documents the naming convention for per-pipeline value-mapping dictionaries. NOT enforced at runtime (dictionaries live in Python modules where any dict[str, str] name is legal). Used by tooling (`ovid2 pipeline validate`) and by contract tests that opt in.

additionalProperties.description: Source-value → CDM-code mapping. All keys and values are strings.

$comment: Example: `demographic_race_dict = {'01': '01', 'Asian': '02', ...}`. Applied via the `translate_by_dict` map op with `dict: demographic_race_dict`.
